capabilities: Display credentials in a card view
disambiguation: Not a comprehensive password manager for hundreds of entries; it is designed for quick lookup of a handful of daily-use credentials.
extras: Warning: Avoid syncing the vault to public cloud storage due to the nature of the credential vault.
intentEvidence: Unlike existing manager plugins with a three-column list UI, Account Card Manager focuses on a minimal card-grid view
motivation: The author built it to provide a minimal card-grid view for quick lookup of daily-use credentials, contrasting with existing list-based manager plugins.
problem: Users need a secure, easy-to-access way to store and retrieve website credentials within their Obsidian vault without exposing plaintext data.
summary: A card-style account and password manager that securely stores credentials using AES-GCM-256 encryption and provides one-click copying of sensitive data.
